_meta.note: Machine twin of the pin library. asset_id null = live id not yet captured; a STATIC-inclusive gameAsset.getAllNames fills them (dauntless confirmed the pins are live). collect_time_minutes is the enforced pairing: quests using a pin MUST use its value.
_meta.resolved_2026-08-27: dauntless confirmed: a collect_item action SELF-RESOLVES at the timer, and requires the player to remain on the tile for the whole duration. Stepping off cancels it. The low end of the scale therefore holds and needs no refloating.
_meta.design_consequence: An Action is committed, uninterrupted effort. Never place one where the fiction has the player moving under pressure, being pursued, or reacting; those are dialog or a fight. An Action is the player choosing to stand still and do a thing properly.
